profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer | Enterprise SaaS | Product Focused
profile.summary:
I build full-stack web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, and AI-driven workflows designed to solve real operational problems. My background bridges high-concurrency enterprise microservices and zero-to-one product development as a startup co-founder.

I care deeply about engineering with a purpose and focusing on the actual human and business problems our code is meant to solve to ensure we are building what matters most. I thrive in high-agency teams with great rapport, taking pride in solving complex business bottlenecks and leaving codebases cleaner, clearer, and better prepared for whoever comes next. I bring strong customer empathy to every domain I build in, and I love being an active user of the products I build.

I’m always open to connecting with fellow engineers, founders, and teams working on meaningful products. 

Reach out directly at manolo.martin.dev@gmail.com!

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Drove core feature development and platform performance across global user surfaces. Partner with product and engineering stakeholders to align frontend microservices with backend APIs, optimize system observability, and introduce developer automation tools.  

Drove frontend and backend execution across React, Express, ASP.NET, and Svelte microservices supporting landing, navigation, and core user flows.  

Introduced agent-driven development practices using Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling and Claude Code, automating PR generation and Jira ticketing.  

Enhance monitoring and error tracking across microservices using New Relic, Sentry, and Grafana.

Design and deploy self-service platforms and APIs that eliminate developer bottlenecks, cutting feature rollout times from weeks to minutes.

positions.title: Co-Founder & Technical Lead
positions.description:
Led end-to-end technology strategy and product architecture from early concept through production deployment. Managed cross-functional engineering execution, client discovery, cloud infrastructure, and core full-stack development.  

Architected and launched the core technology platform and Flutter mobile client (React, PostgreSQL, Express.js), delivering secure infrastructure for 500+ users.  

Redesigned the intake flow into an advocate-driven secret code model, dropping user onboarding time from ~10 minutes to 3–5 minutes.  

Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot (LangChain, ChromaDB) for contextual service provider recommendations and engineered automated input moderation pipelines.
  
Built automated CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, managed Azure infrastructure (AKS/ACR), and built/led a distributed team of 6+ engineers.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · React.js · Express.js · JavaScript · Python (Programming Language) · TypeScript · Start-up Ventures · Software Infrastructure · Flutter · Dart · FastAPI · LangChain · Firebase · Microsoft Power Automate · Jira

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Conducted research on leveraging computer vision to enhance safety protocols within advanced manufacturing environments.

Developed Python scripts to capture data from Microsoft Azure Kinect devices using Raspberry Pi, OpenCV and Pyk4a

Engineered data pipelines utilizing Python and socket programming, facilitating analytics and training of AI models for predictive insights and operational efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · GitHub · Ubuntu · Socket Programming · Raspberry Pi

positions.title: Tutoring Specialist
positions.locationName: Fairfax County, Virginia, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Delivered tutoring sessions in Java, C, and Data Structures, catering to up to 4 clients a week, resulting in full letter grade improvements and increases in overall understanding and application of these concepts.

Implemented tutoring strategies that were tailored to the individual learning styles and needs of students, leading to increased student engagement across all tutored subjects. 

In collaboration with a team of 13 tutors, created and fine-tuned strategies specifically designed for college-level learning that helped students pass classes with an 86% success rate.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Data Structures · Algorithms · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked in a cross-functional full-stack team that developed and supported high-performance distributed systems that serve over 3 million users worldwide.

Performed the migration and enhancement of various Postgres tables using Postman, PostgreSQL, Postico, and Docker which improved database performance.

Engaged in pair programming to implement JWT-based user authentication using Typescript and ExpressJs that improved user authentication efficiency across platforms.

Accelerated frontend rebranding initiatives by translating Figma designs into responsive web interfaces using Gitlab, HTML, CSS, and Svelte.

Enhanced API endpoints,managed subscriptions ,and performed maintenance on data streams, utilizing tools such as Kafka, C#, and ASP.NET, which contributed to improvement in data flow efficiency and system stability.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Svelte · TypeScript · SQL · ASP.NET · Express.js · Docker · GitHub · Gitlab

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated in an Agile Scrum team that used Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment practices with Jenkins to develop and support the Nexus Lifecycle product. 

Enhanced front-end application stability and user experience by identifying and rectifying bugs in JavaScript, alongside developing test suites in Jest for React and Redux components.

Collaboratively designed and implemented RESTful endpoints using Java Spring, Hibernate for database interactions, and Selenium-based test suites.

Transitioned GEB test suites from Groovy to Java, using Selenium for improved automation and testing efficiency.

Leveraged tools such as Github, Jira, Confluence, and Slack to increase team efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · Groovy · Selenium Testing · Redux · Java

projects.title: DateMe
projects.description: Created a generative AI date-planning app on a Supabase backend, turning a natural-language prompt into a structured, budget-constrained, multi-stop itinerary. Has a chat interface for users to make changes to plans with natural language with undo functionality and the option for manual edits.

organizations.name: National Society of Black Engineers
organizations.description: The National Society of Black Engineers (NSBE) is one of the largest student-governed organizations based in the United States. NSBE supports and promotes the aspirations of collegiate and pre-collegiate students and technical professionals in engineering and technology.

organizations.name: Colorstack
organizations.description: A tech nonprofit cultivating the strongest cross-campus community of its kind to deliver community building, academic support, and career development opportunities at scale.
